test_run_with_retry: run the test file with retry logic using the run_with_retry CLI wrapper
test_run_with_retry_max_attempts: run the test file with a custom number of retry attempts via --max-attempts
test_run_with_retry_retry_wait: run the test file with a custom wait time between retries via --retry-wait
test_run_with_retry_timeout: run the test file with a custom per-attempt timeout via --timeout
test_run_unittest_files: run unittest files with retry enabled using run_unittest_files from ci_utils
